#include <iostream>
#include <stack>
#include <utility>
using namespace std;

long long ones[20];

struct State {
    long long n;
    int i;
    int stage; // 0: initial, 1: after first call, 2: after second call
    long long result;
    long long times;
};

long long count_ones_iter(long long n, int i) {
    stack<State> st;
    st.push({n, i, 0, 0, 0});
    long long final_result = 0;
    while (!st.empty()) {
        State &s = st.top();
        if (s.stage == 0) {
            s.times = s.i * (s.n / ones[s.i]);
            s.n = s.n % ones[s.i];
            if (s.n == 0) {
                final_result = s.times;
                st.pop();
                if (!st.empty()) {
                    State &parent = st.top();
                    if (parent.stage == 1) {
                        parent.result = final_result;
                        parent.stage = 2;
                        // push second call
                        st.push({ones[parent.i] - parent.n, parent.i - 1, 0, 0, 0});
                    } else if (parent.stage == 2) {
                        long long second = final_result;
                        long long first = parent.result;
                        final_result = parent.times + min(parent.i + first, second);
                        st.pop();
                    }
                }
            } else {
                s.stage = 1;
                // push first call: count_ones(ones[i] - n, i-1)
                st.push({ones[s.i] - s.n, s.i - 1, 0, 0, 0});
            }
        } else if (s.stage == 1) {
            // first call returned, result stored in final_result
            s.result = final_result;
            s.stage = 2;
            // push second call: count_ones(n, i-1)
            st.push({s.n, s.i - 1, 0, 0, 0});
        } else if (s.stage == 2) {
            long long second = final_result;
            long long first = s.result;
            final_result = s.times + min(s.i + first, second);
            st.pop();
        }
    }
    return final_result;
}

int main() {
    ones[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i) ones[i] = ones[i-1] * 10 + 1;
    long long n;
    cin >> n;
    cout << count_ones_iter(n, 16) << endl;
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

long long ones[20];

long long count_ones(long long n, int i) {
    if (i == 1) return n; // base case: only 1's
    long long times = i * (n / ones[i]);
    n = n % ones[i];
    if (n == 0) return times;
    long long a = i + count_ones(ones[i] - n, i-1);
    long long b = count_ones(n, i-1);
    return times + (a < b ? a : b);
}

int main() {
    ones[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i) ones[i] = ones[i-1] * 10 + 1;
    long long n;
    cin >> n;
    cout << count_ones(n, 16) << endl;
    return 0;
}
